content:
pagerduty: PagerDuty alert (P1) — multiple ILB route-propagation failures observed for several private-vpc-prod projects across eu-west1 -> us-west1 cross-region paths. Increased 5xx when calling GCP loadbalancer control-plane APIs. Paging oncall: emily (oncall) :rotating_light:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — Severity: P1. Channel: #incidents. Runbook: ilb-cross-region. Incident owner: emily (oncall). Pager duty run started.

emily (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Quick summary for the channel?

observability-bot: Metrics snapshot: controlplane-api 5xx spike starting 2026-03-15T02:04Z. 5xx rate up to 18% of requests for route-propagation endpoints (projects matching private-vpc-prod-*). Latency also increased x3. Related logs: https://observability.internal/trace/abcd1234 (link).

gcp-status-bot: GCP advisory: "Internal LB control-plane partial degradation" — started 2026-03-15T02:02Z. Reference: https://status.cloud.google.com/incident/ilb-controlplane/2026-03-15. GCP indicates increased error rates from internal routing service and rate-limits on route update APIs in the affected regions.

kevin (networking): Confirming what we see — ILB control-plane 502/503 when applying route updates across regions. This causes ILB route propagation to stall; affected Private VPC customers lose cross-region fanout. Impact: model-serving egress to replicas in other region times out and fall back fails. Evidence from logs:

```
2026-03-15T02:05:12Z ERROR: controlplane-api: project=private-vpc-prod-17 route-update failed status=503 body="backend update failed"
2026-03-15T02:06:01Z WARNING: ilb-sync: propagation-delay > 120s project=private-vpc-prod-42 region=eu-west1 target=us-west1
```

nic (sre): Paging notes: customers on private deployments with cross-region routing enabled are affected. Local (single-region) traffic looks OK. We should treat as service-impacting for those customers and start mitigations.

alex (infra): Quick mitigation brainstorm — options:
- Ask GCP for urgent route replays / force re-propagation (had to escalate).
- Create temporary regional pass-through: spin up a small proxy pool in eu-west1 that routes to hosted endpoints (but note private VPC restrictions).
- Convert some affected Private VPC projects to use dedicated-hosted fallback via our edge (requires tenant opt-in and ipsec changes) — heavy but possible for high-tier customers.

emily (oncall): Prioritize fastest actionable items. Kevin/Nic — can we identify top 5 customers by traffic and impact? Sara, start customer comms draft for those orgs.

sara (support): Pulling list now. Early list (org ids): rwd-corp-55, rwd-enterprise-2, health-ai-7. I'll DM legal for any high-touch wording. Draft status blurb ready for review: "We're investigating degraded connectivity for Private VPC cross-region routing due to a GCP control plane issue. No data loss; serving may be degraded or partially failing for cross-region replicas. We'll update in 15 minutes."

observability-bot: Top affected metrics (last 5m): downstream error-rate for private-vpc-prod projects = 14.8%; request latency p95 increased from 120ms -> 520ms. Trace sample: https://observability.internal/trace/efgh5678

kevin (networking): Practical mitigation we can do now without GCP approval: reduce cross-region sync attempts to avoid hitting rate limits and flood. There's a per-project backoff we can increase via runtime config. If we back off aggressive replays, we avoid worsening the GCP-side throttles and may allow partial recovery for stable routes. I'll push a temporary flag: `ilb.route_propagation.backoff_override=60s` to increase retry jitter.

alex (infra): Command I'll run (will coordinate with kevin):
```
# tweak runtime config for ILB sync
redwoodctl config set --scope=prod --key=ilb.route_propagation.backoff_override --value=60s
```

nic (sre): Agree with backoff. Also we should disable auto-replay-on-failure for a window (5-10m) to avoid heartbeat storms. Will prepare a config patch.

emily (oncall): Go ahead with backoff change. Alex, run in staging first then prod. Keep me posted. Sara, post the first customer message once we have the list and impacted regions.

oncall-next: I'll take the 30-minute follow-up and prepare the incident doc. Please DM me any handover items.

kevin (networking): Rolling out backoff override to prod now (eu-west1 first):
```
redwoodctl rollout start --service=ilb-sync --regions=eu-west1 --config=backoff-60s
```

incident-bot: Deployment event detected: ilb-sync/backoff-override -> eu-west1. CI: OK. Monitor.

observability-bot: Post-change snapshot (2m after): controlplane 5xx down from 18% -> 9% for eu-west1. Latency p95 improving slightly. Still seeing intermittent 503s.

gcp-status-bot: Update from GCP: "We are investigating control-plane surge; mitigation actions being applied. Customers may see intermittent route propagation failures. Patching in progress."

alex (infra): As a secondary mitigation for the top 3 customers, we can provision short-lived dedicated routing proxies in-region with NAT egress to our hosted endpoints. This requires firewall and peering changes; will take ~20-30m. Recommend for rwd-corp-55 and rwd-enterprise-2 only.

sara (support): Customer messaging: drafted detailed note for enterprise customers (cc legal): "Root cause: upstream GCP ILB control-plane error causing route propagation failures for Private VPC cross-region traffic. Impact: intermittent request failures to cross-region replicas. Mitigation: temporary backoff and targeted regional proxy fallbacks. ETA for next update: 15m." Approving now.

nic (sre): I've opened a support escalation with GCP (Case ID: GCP-2026-3347). They've acknowledged and assigned a P1 engineer. Sharing link to case notes.

emily (oncall): Good. Summary for exec/status page: cause = GCP ILB control-plane errors affecting route updates; scope = subset of Private VPC customers using cross-region routing (eu-west1<->us-west1); impact = degraded/failed cross-region traffic; mitigation = backoff override applied, target proxy fallbacks for top customers, GCP escalation.

oncall-next: Taking over incident owner in 15m — will post handoff shortly. Emily — please add any context I should know in DM.

incident-bot: Severity remains P1. Incident timeline being recorded at https://incidents.redwood/1887654321.

gcp-status-bot: New update: "Control-plane errors mitigated for some zones. Full remediation ETA unknown. Continued monitoring."

kevin (networking): Backoff rollout looks effective. Will prepare proxy infra plan as soon as we confirm customer approval.

sara (support): Sent initial notices to affected customers (rwd-corp-55, rwd-enterprise-2, health-ai-7). Copied oncall and account teams.

emily (oncall): Handoff: oncall-next is incident owner. I'll stay nearby for questions. Next update due in 15m or sooner if GCP provides new info. Closing my active page. :white_check_mark:

oncall-next: Acknowledged. Taking ownership. I'll update timeline and next steps in the incident doc. Continuing monitoring and coordinating with GCP.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED FOR EMILY (oncall) HANDOFF — new owner oncall-next. Keep posting updates in this thread."
